mcp.description: JobGuardianAI MCP server exposing JobStatus, KnowledgeBase, and ActionHistory entities for the SQL job monitoring agent.

fields.name: KnowledgeBaseId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge base entry.

fields.name: FailureType
fields.description: Short category name for the type of job failure, e.g. Deadlock, Timeout, Missing File.

fields.name: ErrorPattern
fields.description: Substring matched (case-insensitive) against a failed job's error message to identify this entry.

fields.name: RootCause
fields.description: Human-readable explanation of why this failure typically occurs.

fields.name: RecommendedAction
fields.description: The remediation step recommended when this failure pattern matches.

fields.name: McpTool
fields.description: Name of the MCP/automation tool that can carry out the recommended action, e.g. RetryJob, SendEmail.

fields.name: AutomationLevel
fields.description: How much autonomy the agent has for this entry: Automatic, Approval, or Manual.

fields.name: Confidence
fields.description: Confidence score (0-100) that this entry correctly diagnoses a matching failure.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Whether this knowledge base entry is currently active and eligible for matching.

fields.name: CreatedDate
fields.description: UTC timestamp when this knowledge base entry was created.

fields.name: ActionHistoryId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the recorded action.

fields.name: JobName
fields.description: Name of the SQL Agent job the action was taken for.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.description: The error message reported by the failed job execution.

fields.name: RootCause
fields.description: Root cause identified for the failure, usually copied from the matched KnowledgeBase entry.

fields.name: ActionName
fields.description: The action that was recommended or executed, e.g. Retry Job, Notify DBA.

fields.name: ActionResult
fields.description: Outcome of the action, e.g. Success, Failed, Pending Approval.

fields.name: McpTool
fields.description: Name of the MCP/automation tool used to carry out the action.

fields.name: ExecutedBy
fields.description: Who or what executed the action, e.g. JobAgent or a user name.

fields.name: ExecutedDate
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the action was executed or recorded.

fields.name: JobId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the SQL Agent job (msdb.dbo.sysjobs.job_id).

fields.name: JobName
fields.description: Display name of the SQL Agent job.

fields.name: CurrentStatus
fields.description: Outcome of the job's most recent run: Failed, Succeeded, Retry, Cancelled, Running, or Unknown.

fields.name: LastExecutionTime
fields.description: Date and time the job last ran.

fields.name: DurationSeconds
fields.description: How long the last run took, in seconds.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.description: Message reported by the last job step, including failure details when the run failed.

fields.name: IsFailed
fields.description: 1 if the job's last run failed, otherwise 0.

fields.name: IsEnabled
fields.description: 1 if the SQL Agent job is currently enabled, otherwise 0.

fields.name: ServerName
fields.description: Name of the SQL Server instance the job ran on.
